expected.logged: [Backup] Refusing to restore backup "<filename>" because it belongs to slot ID slot-b, not the active slot slot-a.

notes: The guard (lines 611-620) only fires when the backup carries a non-nil `slotId` from its sidecar AND `WorldSlotManager.resolvedActiveSlotID` resolves successfully. A legacy backup with no slot association at all (nil slotId) always passes this check regardless of which slot is currently active, since `if let backupSlotId = backup.slotId` short-circuits to skip the comparison entirely.
